entities.name: Sarraza
entities.description: Mountain in the Borderlands of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria.

entities.name: Samor
entities.description: Songmage who bound the Beast of the Hours beneath Sarraza.

entities.name: Valley of the Chimes
entities.description: Hidden valley behind the mountain whose chimes power a banishing spell.

entities.name: Borderlands
entities.description: Smaller island southwest of Almaaz including Sarraza.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: Flooding that cut Sarraza off from Almaaz.

entities.name: Almaaz
entities.description: Island Sarraza was cut off from.

events.summary: Samor binds the Beast of the Hours beneath Sarraza.
events.quote: the songmage Samor bound the cockatrice called the Beast of the Hours beneath the mountain

events.summary: Samor discovers the hidden valley of the Chimes and uses its magic to create a spell to banish the beast.
events.quote: used the magic of its great chimes to create a spell that would banish the beast

events.summary: The flooding of the Thaw cuts Sarraza off from the rest of Almaaz.
events.quote: it became cut off from the rest of Almaaz by the flooding of the Thaw

relations.quote: the songmage Samor bound the cockatrice
is a mountain in the Borderlands
